G0625.name: Apollos
G0625.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0625.brief: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul
G0625.short: Apollos, an eloquent and learned Jewish Christian from Alexandria, was an important figure in the early church who worked alongside Paul in spreading the gospel.

G0682.name: Apphia
G0682.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G0682.brief: Recipient of Paul's letter to Philemon
G0682.short: Apphia, likely a member of Philemon's household, was one of the recipients of Paul's letter to Philemon.

G0624.name: Apollonia
G0624.brief: A city in Macedonia visited by Paul.
G0624.short: Apollonia, a city in Macedonia through which Paul passed on his way to Thessalonica.

G0697.name: Areopagus
G0697.brief: A hill in Athens where Paul preached the gospel.
G0697.short: The Areopagus, a hill in Athens where Paul addressed the philosophers and preached about the unknown God.

G0675.name: Forum of Appius
G0675.brief: Marketplace on Appian Way; Christians met Paul on journey to Rome
G0675.short: The Forum of Appius, a marketplace on the Appian Way, where Christians from Rome met Paul during his journey to the city as a prisoner.
